statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The diagnosis codes are R55 and G45.9
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
Mobile cardiac telemetry was medically necessary to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic instability contributing to syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
